name: Exp_3rdGenerationXMA
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the 3rd Generation XMA (Extended Moving Average) indicator, entering long when the smoothed value rises and short when it falls. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) and applies multi-timeframe analysis with a default H4 timeframe. Position sizing supports either fixed lot or percentage-based allocation, with stop loss and take profit for risk control.
summary_zh: 该EA基于第三代XMA（扩展移动平均）指标信号进行交易，当平滑值上升时做多，下降时做空。它支持多种可配置的平滑方法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等），默认使用H4多周期分析。仓位管理支持固定手数或百分比分配，并设有止损止盈进行风险控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于第三代XMA指标的平滑趋势判断，通过对价格数据进行双重平滑来减少噪音并识别趋势方向。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标值从前2根K线到前1根K线上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（最新值继续上升）时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空单。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数大小，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的封装函数执行交易，支持买卖权限独立控制，但缺乏加仓、减仓或追踪止损等动态仓位调整机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 3rd Generation XMA indicator's smoothed trend identification, applying double smoothing to price data to reduce noise and determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a long position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator rising from 2 bars ago to 1 bar ago) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continues rising); a short position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse signals for position closing, with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot size and positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management relies on wrapped functions in TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution, with independent buy/sell permission controls, but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms such as scaling, partial close, or trailing stop.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易存款比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade deposit percentage; negative value = fixed lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA为-100~+100，VIDIA为CMO周期，AMA为慢MA周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (-100~+100 for JJMA, CMO period for VIDIA, slow MA period for AMA)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用第三代XMA双重平滑算法，有效减少市场噪音，信号质量较高
支持10种平滑方法和11种价格类型，策略灵活性很强
多时间框架分析，可在高周期确认趋势后交易，减少假信号
买卖权限可独立控制，便于组合多种策略或单向交易
有新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
pros_en: Uses 3rd generation XMA double smoothing algorithm to effectively reduce market noise and improve signal quality
Supports 10 smoothing methods and 11 price types, providing strong strategy flexibility
Multi-timeframe analysis allows trading after trend confirmation on higher timeframes, reducing false signals
Independent buy/sell permission controls enable strategy combination or directional-only trading
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated position opening within the same bar
cons: 缺乏追踪止损机制，趋势行情中可能过早止盈或止损过远
止损1000点、止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整
仅在反向信号时平仓，无额外的趋势衰竭或加速判断，可能在震荡市中频繁开平仓
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
MM参数负值表示固定手数的设计容易混淆，且缺乏最小手数和最大手数限制
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop mechanism, which may lead to premature take profit or overly distant stop loss in trending markets
Fixed 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
Only closes positions on reverse signals without additional trend exhaustion or acceleration criteria, potentially causing frequent open/close in ranging markets
No check for existing same-direction positions, which may lead to duplicate position opening
Negative MM value for fixed lot size is confusing by design, and lacks minimum/maximum lot size limits
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，替代固定点数，适应不同市场波动环境
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
增加同方向持仓检查，避免重复开仓；增加震荡市过滤器（如ADX）减少假信号
改进MM参数设计，使用枚举明确区分固定手数和百分比模式，增加手数上下限保护
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit calculation instead of fixed points to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets
Add same-direction position check to avoid duplicate entries; add ranging market filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals
Improve MM parameter design by using an enumeration to clearly distinguish between fixed lot and percentage modes, and add lot size upper/lower limit protection

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未适配市场波动性，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止损过小
未检查同方向已有持仓，可能重复开仓导致仓位过重
SignalBar=1时使用已完成K线信号相对安全，但SignalBar=0时使用未完成K线信号存在重绘风险
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit not adapted to market volatility - stop too large in low volatility, too small in high volatility
No check for existing same-direction positions may cause duplicate entries leading to excessive position sizing
SignalBar=1 uses completed bar signals which is relatively safe, but SignalBar=0 uses incomplete bar signals with repainting risk
